bull_case: 경영진은 CUDA→AI 데이터센터→full-stack AI factory로 장기간 기술 전환을 선도했고 Rubin·NVLink·네트워킹·CPU로 자원을 재배치했다. H1 FY27 $39.8B 자사주와 대규모 R&D/생태계 투자는 강한 현금창출을 성장과 주주환원에 병행 배분한다.
bear_case: $99B equity investments, $366B 미래약정, AI cloud 지원과 장기 lease는 제국건설·고객수요 지원 위험을 키운다. 창업자 의존도와 성과보상의 상승도 감독이 필요하다.
thesis: 실행력과 장기 기술 자본배분은 강하다. 현재 10-Q에서 disclosure controls가 effective로 평가됐고 2026 proxy는 CEO 목표보상의 96%가 성과 의존이라고 명시한다. 다만 최근 생태계 투자·보증·인프라 약정의 규모가 커져 향후 자본배분 규율을 더 엄격히 검증해야 한다.

evidence.claim: Management concluded disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of July 26, 2026, with no material change in internal control over financial reporting during Q2 FY27.
evidence.value: Controls effective; no material ICFR change

evidence.claim: The 2026 proxy states 96% of the CEO's FY2026 target pay and 48% of other NEO target pay depended on corporate performance, with performance-based PSUs and TSR components.
NVIDIA repurchased 203M shares for $39.8B in H1 FY27 and authorized an additional $80B repurchase program.
NVIDIA disclosed $99B of equity investments plus $25B of equity investment commitments and large infrastructure/customer-support commitments.

counterevidence: Large ecosystem investments and guarantees can become empire-building if returns are not disclosed.
Founder/CEO strategic centrality creates key-person concentration.
Buybacks at high valuations can destroy value if intrinsic-value discipline is weak.
Performance compensation tied to operating income/TSR can still encourage scale and market-value targets rather than pure owner earnings.
unknowns: Standalone returns on ecosystem equity investments and AI-cloud support
Board challenge process for very large strategic commitments
Long-run succession readiness beyond founder-led strategy

uncertainties.rationale: Historical execution is excellent but recent commitments are unprecedented in size.
Current controls are effective; no material accounting integrity issue identified.
Roadmap execution has been strong, with residual founder/key-person risk.

falsifiers: Material restatement or control weakness emerges.
Large ecosystem investments produce persistent losses without strategic or cash-flow returns.
Roadmap misses or supply commitments repeatedly force material write-offs.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current filings state disclosure controls are effective, and no restatement/material accounting-control issue was identified in the reviewed NVIDIA filings.

key_kpis.name: Strategic investment returns
key_kpis.threshold: Cash-flow/strategic benefits become observable relative to capital committed

key_kpis.name: Roadmap execution
key_kpis.threshold: Major architecture ramps broadly on schedule

subscores.rationale: Growth investment and capital return track record are strong, but recent ecosystem commitments are large and less transparent.
Controls are effective and pay is performance-linked; founder/key-person concentration remains.
Multiple architecture transitions and expansion into networking/CPU show exceptional adaptation.
